record.title: The Mender's Satchel
record.premise: Old Teeka's satchel is in Hanu-Mah's chest, and the letter in it decides whose it should be.

things.name: Letter in Teeka's Hand
things.text: Hanu, the satchel and all in it are yours when I am gone. You mend better than I ever did. - Teeka

stages.journalText: Old Teeka, the mender of Yulca, says her satchel of needles and gut was carried off to Hanu-Mah's hut on the west causeway. I'm to ask Hanu-Mah for it.

objectives.objectiveText: Ask Hanu-Mah for Old Teeka's satchel.

topics.label: What do you need?
topics.intent: Teeka's satchel of needles and gut went off with Hanu-Mah to her hut on the west causeway; she wants it back before the nets come in.

topics.label: Tell me about Yulca.
topics.intent: Yulca is a fishing village on causeways over the water; its nets need mending every dry season.

topics.label: Old Teeka wants her satchel back.
topics.intent: No. Teeka promised it to her; it stays in her chest, and the key stays on her belt.

topics.label: Here is your satchel.
topics.intent: Teeka takes it, counts her needles, and pays ten gold. Hanu-Mah can wait her turn.

topics.label: Teeka's letter says this is yours.
topics.intent: Hanu-Mah takes it and says she will mend Teeka's nets for nothing, as long as Teeka lives.

topics.label: (Persuade) Let me look in the chest; I will settle it with Teeka.
topics.intent: She shrugs and says the chest is only a novice's lock; she will not stop anyone who picks it.
topics.fallback: She tells you to mind your own business.

answers: Notes: Quest The Mender's Satchel is done. Old Teeka, mender of Yulca, wanted her satchel back from Hanu-Mah, who kept it in a locked chest at her hut on the west causeway, saying Teeka promised it to her. I picked the chest (took 3 lockpicks from the hut). A letter in Teeka's hand there gives Hanu-Mah the satchel only when Teeka is gone; since Teeka lives, I returned the satchel to Teeka, who paid me 10 gold and said Hanu-Mah can wait her turn. I left the letter in the chest. I now have 10 gold and the lockpicks. Hanu-Mah probably resents the break-in; I did not go back to talk to her. Nothing is left outstanding that I know of.
